title: Quick Springy Middle-Eastern Chickpea Pilaf
description: This herbal and springy Middle-Eastern dish features yellow pepper and is kid-friendly. It's also gluten-free-friendly, making it an excellent option for lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the diced yellow bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas to the saucepan and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are coated in the spice mixture.
Use a fluffing fork to gently knead the chickpea mixture, breaking up any clumps.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped parsley and gluten-free breadcrumbs if desired.
